arcticfox: An adult Arctic fox, thick white winter coat, short rounded ears, short blunt muzzle, very bushy tail, standing squarely on all four legs in profile
badger: An adult honey badger, low stocky body, broad pale grey saddle running from the crown to the tail over a black face and underside, blunt snout, long front claws, walking on all four legs
beaver: An adult beaver, heavy brown-furred body, broad flat scaly paddle tail trailing behind it, large orange incisors, small round ears, standing on all four legs
boar: An adult wild boar, heavy bristled dark brown body, high shoulder hump, long straight snout, small upward-curving tusks at the lower jaw, standing on all four legs
cheetah: An adult cheetah, lean deep-chested tan body covered in solid round black spots, small rounded head, black tear stripes running from the inner corner of each eye down to the mouth, long tail, standing on all four legs
cobra: An adult king cobra, long olive-brown snake with the front third of its body reared up and its hood fully spread, smooth scales, no legs
croc: An adult saltwater crocodile, long armoured olive-brown body with heavy raised scutes along the back, broad long snout with interlocking teeth showing along the jawline, four short splayed legs, long muscular tail, standing low on all four legs
fennec: An adult fennec fox, small pale cream body with enormous triangular ears, slender legs, sharply pointed muzzle, black-tipped bushy tail, standing on all four legs
hedgehog: An adult hedgehog, rounded body densely covered in stiff banded brown and cream spines, pale furred face with a pointed snout and small dark eyes, short legs, walking on all four legs
hyena: An adult spotted hyena, sloping back with powerful shoulders standing higher than the hips, sandy coat with dark round spots, broad blunt muzzle, rounded ears, standing on all four legs
jaguar: An adult jaguar, heavily built muscular tan cat marked with dark rosettes that each enclose small central spots, broad blocky head with powerful jaws, short thick tail, standing on all four legs
kestrel: An adult common kestrel, slender falcon with a rufous back barred in black, pale spotted underparts, grey head and tail, a dark moustache stripe below the eye, hooked beak, upright with wings folded
leopard: An adult leopard, muscular golden cat covered in dark rosettes, solid black spots on the head and legs, heavy head, long white-tipped tail, standing on all four legs
lion: An adult male African lion, heavy tawny body with a full dark mane framing the face and running back over the shoulders and onto the chest, broad muzzle, tufted tail, standing squarely on all four legs in profile
lovebird: An adult lovebird, small stocky parrot with a bright green body, peach-red face and throat, blue rump, pale hooked beak, short squared tail, upright with wings folded
lynx: An adult Eurasian lynx, thick pale grey-brown coat with faint dark spots, long black tufts on the ear tips, a flared cheek ruff framing the face, very short black-tipped tail, long legs, standing on all four legs
manedwolf: An adult maned wolf, tall fox-like animal on very long black legs, rich reddish-orange coat, large upright ears, a black mane along the neck and shoulders, white throat and white tail tip, standing on all four legs
otter: An adult river otter, long sleek dark brown body, thick tapering tail, short legs with webbed feet, broad whiskered face with small ears, walking on all four legs
owl: An adult tawny owl, round-headed owl with mottled brown and buff plumage, large dark forward-facing eyes set in a plain facial disc, small hooked beak, upright with wings folded
rabbit: An adult brown hare, long lean body with very long black-tipped ears, powerful long hind legs, amber eyes, tawny brown coat with a pale belly, alert on all fours
redfox: An adult red fox, slender rust-red body with a white throat and belly, black stockings on the legs, pointed muzzle, large upright ears, very bushy white-tipped tail, standing on all four legs
snowleopard: An adult snow leopard, thick smoky-grey coat patterned with dark rosettes, small rounded head, very long thick tail nearly as long as its body, oversized paws, standing on all four legs
tiger: An adult Bengal tiger, large muscular orange cat with bold black vertical stripes, white cheek ruff and underside, broad head, long tail, standing squarely on all four legs in profile
wilddog: An adult African wild dog, lean long-legged dog with a mottled patchwork coat of black, tan and white, very large rounded ears, dark muzzle, white-tipped tail, standing on all four legs
wolf: An adult grey wolf, large deep-chested wolf with a thick grizzled grey coat, long legs, broad head with erect triangular ears, amber eyes, bushy tail carried low, standing on all four legs
